Master Listing CRM App
for Malaysian Real Estate Agents

Manage agency property listings, Vault documents, loan calculators, and case tracking securely from your Android device.

Download Official APK (v1.5.0)
📱 Android 8.0+ (Universal APK) 🔒 Verified & Secure (Direct Download)
✨ What's New in Version 1.5.0:
  • ✨ Dedicated Settings Pages: Account, Notifications, and Help & Support now open as clean, full-screen pages with smooth back navigation.
  • 📐 Grid Alignment & Share Button: Master Listing grid cards now have equalized heights with perfectly aligned Share buttons.
  • 🔍 My Listings Filter Fix: All your properties (Active, Booking, Sold, Draft) are now always visible under My Listings by default.
  • 🛡️ Redesigned Feedback & Bug Report: Easily report issues and attach screenshots with comfortable safe-area spacing and gesture back support.
